agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (3: m~19.65 and 4: m~14.39) fall toward each other. By step 11 distance ~0.917, by step 12 distance ~0.453 close to softening 0.3, potential drops sharply to -1551, kinetic spikes to 1413, and substeps remain only 6 despite dt=0.0325 high. Leapfrog with insufficient adaptive sub-stepping fails to resolve the close encounter, causing total energy to jump from -199.35 at step 11 to -137.76 at step 12 (delta ~62 vs initial -206), violating conservation. Reducing dt to 0.005 eliminates violation.
